_comment: Engine knobs. Rarely edited. EQUAL-WEIGHT MODEL: every pillar counts the same. The master signal for a window is the SIMPLE MEAN of all pillar signals (the qualitative pillars in scores.json + the computed Bitcoin-TA pillar). Add a pillar and it auto-rebalances to 1/N. 'impact' is a single uniform value shared by ALL pillars (deliberately flat, so pillars differ only by their P odds and Quality). final_weights define THE FINAL NUMBER across windows (equal is the headline; horizon is the longer-money variant).

quality_basis.1: 835+ weekly bars, indicator agreement; edge modest by design
quality_basis.3: monthly bars + analog sample thin (n=3) but unanimous
quality_basis.6: quarterly layer weakest; inputs can disagree in sign; analog windows flip (n=3)
quality_basis.12: analogs 3/3 positive + power-law converge; n=3 is thin
quality_basis.36: n=3, regime-unique tailwinds in analogs; halving effect may be attenuating
